clips.transcript: All this, what I've just described, needs massive investment. At least 500 billion euros, according to our own estimates.

clips.transcript: And that's the trick, because none of us can do it alone. Siemens can't. Yes, we do produce. We produce trains, substations and so on. But we don't have enough data. OHB doesn't have enough data, and also KION doesn't have enough data.
